title: 第9章 水果店上线&amp;第一单芒果卖出去
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“哎呦！我的老腰。”

    林蒹葭疲惫地进了屋，脱了鞋将包包一丢，浑身如同被抽走骨头一样倒下。

    她双脚抬着靠在墙上，身体躺在地板上，双眼放空，目光涣散地盯着天花板。

    “主人，欢迎您回家，今天工作还满意吗？”

    屋内的家居机器人贴心地迎了上来，捡走被随意丢在地上的包包和外套。

    林蒹葭视线动了动，摊开的手掌对着天花板比了一个中指。

    “好个屁，天杀的老板不做人，天天压榨我们，简直不把星际法当一回事。”

    “我昨晚加班到现在，抠门老板才给我一天休息，别的星球月亮是真圆，可恶！”

    生活机器人咕噜噜拿着衣服划走，随后又端回来一杯温开水递到林蒹葭嘴边。

    “主人，别灰心，您还有五天发工资。这一笔工资将会创造新高，您终于可以买自己想要的包包。”

    林蒹葭对着天花板叹了口气，翻身趴在地上，接过温度正好的水一口喝了。

    她潇洒地用手背擦了下嘴巴，对着小机器人认真道：

    “说真的，公司福利待遇也就勉强，虽然一周只休息两天半，但是每个月发放工资还算及时，你说对吧？”

    生活机器人的屏幕跳了跳，“是的主人，您只需要把领导当屁放就好。”

    “有一个好消息，您预定的顶级牛肉发货了，预计下午三点到家。”

    林蒹葭摸了下机器人光滑的脑门，“小爱，还是你最好，我要去睡一觉，等牛肉到了你叫我。”

    “收到主人，热水已放好，您请好好睡一觉。”

    林蒹葭拖着疲惫的身体起身，一边脱衣服一边进浴室。

    她靠在浴缸内，无聊地点开终端，划着星网头条资讯。

    #星际海盗攻破了一个新生星球#

    #蓝白星成为旅游热门城市#

    #蓝白星棒子国国服入选星际最佳服装前十#

    林蒹葭在最后一条热搜上面顿住，点开下面评论，全是棒子国人的吹捧。

    说什么还是她们老祖宗厉害，传下来的服装入选了本年度星际最佳前十。

    还有人不要脸地艾特了花国官方，让花国人全部来看看什么叫传承。

    “什么玩意，谁稀罕看你。”

    林蒹葭忍不住吐槽了两句，烦躁地退出热搜频道。

    不仅如此，被艾特来的花国人也纷纷表示不感兴趣。
content_en:
"Ouch! My old waist."

    Lin Jianjia entered the house tiredly, took off her shoes and threw away her bag, and fell down as if her bones had been taken away.

    She leaned against the wall with her feet raised, her body lying on the floor, her eyes vacant, staring at the ceiling.

    "Master, welcome home. Are you satisfied with your work today?"

    The home robot in the house warmly came over and picked up the bags and coats that had been thrown on the ground.

    Lin Jianjia's eyes moved, and her open palm pointed at the ceiling with her middle finger.

    "What a piece of shit! The damn boss is so inconsiderate that he squeezes us every day and doesn't take interstellar law seriously."

    "I worked overtime last night, and my stingy boss only gave me a day off. The moon on other planets is really round, damn it!"

    The life robot Gululu took the clothes and rowed away, then brought back a glass of warm water and handed it to Lin Jianjia's mouth.

    "Master, don't be discouraged, you still have five days to get paid. This salary will reach a new high, and you can finally buy the bag you want."

    Lin Jianjia sighed at the ceiling, turned over and lay on the ground, took the water at the right temperature and drank it in one gulp.

    She wiped her mouth coolly with the back of her hand and said seriously to the little robot:

    "To be honest, the company's welfare benefits are barely adequate. Although we only have two and a half days off a week, the monthly salary payment is quite timely, right?"

    The screen of the life robot jumped, "Yes, master, you just need to treat the leader like a fart."

    "There is good news. The top-quality beef you ordered has been shipped. It is expected to arrive home at three in the afternoon."

    Lin Jianjia touched the robot's smooth forehead and said, "Xiao Ai, it's better for you. I'm going to take a nap. You can call me when the beef arrives."

    "Received from the master, the hot water has been put on. Please have a good sleep."

    Lin Jianjia dragged her tired body up and entered the bathroom while taking off her clothes.

    She leaned in the bathtub, opened the terminal in boredom, and scrolled through the headlines of Star Network.

    #Interstellar Pirates captured a new planet#

    #蓝白星 has become a popular tourist city#

    #蓝白星 Bangziguo’s national costume was selected into the top ten of the best costumes in the interstellar world#

    Lin Jianjia paused at the last hot search and clicked on the comments below. They were all compliments from Bangzi people.

    After all, their ancestors are still great, and the costumes passed down were selected into the top ten of the best in the interstellar industry this year.

    Some people shamelessly invited the Flower Country officials to ask all the Flower Country people to come and see what inheritance is.

    "What the hell, no one wants to look at you."

    Lin Jianjia couldn't help but complain a few words, and exited the hot search channel irritably.

    Not only that, the people from Huaguo who were invited by Aite also expressed their disinterest.
